messages.content: How to obtain the detailed case information of the 'R vs Adams' legal case?

function.name: legal_case_fetch
function.description: Fetch detailed legal case information from database. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_id.description: The ID of the legal case.

details.description: True if need the detail info.

message.content:
Below you’ll find two complementary approaches: | Goal | How to do it | |------|--------------| | **1️⃣ Find the official record** (court docket, judgment text, filings) | • Identify which jurisdiction handled *R v Adams* – e.g., UK Crown Court, US federal district court, Canadian superior court, etc.
• Use the court’s online portal:
 – UK: [HMCTS Case Search](https://www.gov.uk/court-records)
 – USA: PACER (Public Access to Court Electronic Records), state‑specific portals
 – Canada: CanLII or provincial court websites
• If the case is older than ~10 years, many jurisdictions keep PDFs on their archives page.
• For civil cases, check LexisNexis / Westlaw / Bloomberg Law for full opinions. | | **2️⃣ Request the file through formal means** | • File a Freedom‑of‑Information Act (FOI/Privacy Act) application with the relevant agency.
• Submit a “Request for Public Record” form at the courthouse where the case was heard.
• Pay any applicable filing fee (often $5–$20).
• Some courts offer electronic requests via MyCasePortal or similar systems. | | **3️⃣ Leverage open data & research services** | • Many countries publish judicial decisions under Creative Commons licenses. Check or national equivalents.
• Services such as CourtListener, Justia, or Google Scholar often index judgments automatically. | --- ### Using the built‑in helper (`legal_case_fetch`) If you already know the internal case ID used by your system/database, simply invoke the helper below. Replace `"CASE_ID_HERE"` with the real identifier. ```python from functions import legal_case_fetch result = legal_case_fetch({ "case_id": "CASE_ID_HERE", # e.g., "UK_CROWN_2020_045" "details": True # set to False if only summary needed }) print(result) ``` This will return a JSON object containing: - Full citation - Parties involved - Judgment text (or link to PDF) - Filing dates - Related documents (motions, orders) If you don’t yet have a numeric ID but just the name (“R vs Adams”), first perform a preliminary lookup in the public docket system described above to retrieve the exact docket number or case reference. Once you have that, feed it into the helper. --- #### Quick checklist before making the request 1. Confirm jurisdiction → ensures correct portal/API. 2. Verify whether the case has been sealed or contains protected personal data. 3. Prepare identification proof if required (e.g., lawyer badge, government ID). Let me know if you’d like help locating the docket number or navigating a particular court’s website!
